reasons.specificity: The map closely tracks Chen’s distinct reconstruction of Jaeggi, Kuhnian analogy test, psychologist alternative, and slavery, marriage, childhood, and Nazism applications.
reasons.anchoring: Nearly all quotations occur and support the stated points, though some prose extends beyond its anchors by treating modern marriage as a direct pragmatist learning-and-capacity application.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully distinguishes disputed problem recognition from technical problem-solving, theoretical incommensurability from practical know-how, and social constitution from neutral justification.
reasons.coherence: Framework attribution and relations are largely consistent across tables and findings, but the prose occasionally shifts Chen’s counterexamples into applications of Jaeggi’s framework more strongly than the source does.
reasons.usefulness: The component–relation and application–limit tables provide an effective text-open guide and foreground both the inquiry and the article’s explicit perspectival limit.
reasons.hallucination_risk: Claims are overwhelmingly source-based and carefully bounded, but the asserted absence of any procedure beyond collective judgment and the pragmatist reading of modern marriage are interpretive extrapolations rather than explicit conclusions.

decisive_errors.claim: “The pragmatist explanation treats abolition or modern marriage as progress because a crisis is resolved through learning and enhanced capacities.”
decisive_errors.counter_passage: Chen presents modern marriage as a counterexample: it solves “the problems of individual interest and freedom of mate selection” while producing “serious problems” such as rising divorce and declining birth rates, and later says it is progress because “we collectively believe” liberty and happiness matter more than reproduction.
decisive_errors.why: The analysis converts Chen’s critical test case into a straightforward application of Jaeggi’s experience-enrichment mechanism.

score.one_line: A highly specific and useful framework map with strong source anchoring, weakened mainly by one overextended characterization of the modern-marriage counterexample.
